description: Evidence-gated sizing ladder. 'Risk higher during challenge' is a policy with steps and gates, not an impulse. Rungs advance ONLY when gate conditions are met from the journal; any rung's drawdown trigger drops one rung immediately. Consumed by operators and (later) position_sizing_engine.

rungs.advance_gate: 20 journaled fills AND PF >= 1.3 over those fills
40 journaled fills AND PF >= 1.3 AND max drawdown < $1,500
$3K live gate cleared — at this point the conversation is live accounts, not bigger demo

policies.demote_trigger: 3 consecutive losses at current rung OR daily loss > $600

policies.context: Topstep 50K combine: $3,000 target, $2,000 max loss limit, $1,000 daily loss. Challenge mode = front-load risk while loss headroom is full, de-risk as headroom shrinks.

rungs.condition: loss headroom > $1,500 — full headroom justifies challenge-mode sizing on the VERIFIED edge only
loss headroom < $700 — survival mode; one bad day from failure

hard_rules: challenge-mode sizing applies ONLY to strategies with verdict 'verified' from the config-parity gate; experiments always trade minimum size
after target cleared: minimum size only until payout eligibility (consistency rules)
never trade the last $300 of headroom — a failed combine costs a reset fee AND calendar time
policies.current_note: 50K-A headroom unknown-thin (balance $47,875) -> rung 3 sizing until headroom verified. 50K-B inactive.
